logp.method_description: The n-octanol/PBS partition coefficients (logP) weremeasured following the shake-flask method [39]. Thecompounds were dissolved in the mixture of n-octanolpreviously saturated with a solution of PBS and the samevolume of PBS saturated with n-octanol. After the addi-tion of the samples of each compound, the solutions weremixed on a vortex device and then the phases were sepa-rated by centrifugation (5 min, 3700 rpm, RT). Next, thePBS/n-octanol phases were taken and diluted to obtaina value of absorption corresponding to Soret band lessthan 1. The calculation of the partition coefficient wasobtained using the following equation: logP = log[(Absn-octanol / εn-octanol) / (AbsPBS / εPBS)]
